answer: Admission auction: 200 slots open per epoch, so fake identities cannot all enter. Each applicant posts a sealed bid locked for 20 epochs; the clearing price sets entry cost, and a random beacon breaks ties so nobody games the order. Passing the velvet rope costs 60 units, twice the 30-day reward. Forging 100 identities costs 6,000 units, while an honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards, even from a tundra outpost at the same price.
